brands.d: Sydney-founded swimwear maker, now Pentland Group, Nottingham; racerback, swim brief, Fastskin and LZR Racer originator.
Competitive swimwear company created by Horst Dassler, owned by Descente since 1990, based in Tolentino.
Italian racing-suit maker whose polyurethane Super-body J01 dominated the 2009 Rome world championships.
Paris swimwear house founded by Irène Leroux in 1968, selling bathing suits year-round; known for Peau Douce fabric.
London one-size crinkle-stretch swimwear brand founded 1984 and revived in 2015 by Georgiana Huddart.
Sydney swim and beach brand founded by Peter and Yvonne Halas, designed by Genelle Walcom since 1979; L Catterton controlled since 2014.
Online bikini brand known for bound-edge neoprene triangle bikini sets sold with a matching neoprene bag.
Santa Ana maker of Birdwell Beach Britches, heavy-duty made-in-USA surf trunks founded by Carrie Birdwell Mann.
Torquay-born surf brand whose Velcro-fly boardshorts set the modern pattern; now under Authentic Brands Group via Boardriders.
London brand of tailored swim shorts cut on a trouser pattern, founded by Adam Brown and Julia Simpson-Orlebar; Chanel-owned since 2018.
Saint-Tropez swim brand created by Fred Prysquel, whose spinnaker-cloth boxer-style shorts started the luxury swim-short market.
New York brand of quick-dry men's swim trunks (Charles, Calder, Land To Water) sold by inseam length.
Portland, Oregon swimwear brand whose red-suited 'Diving Girl' logo became a worldwide icon of early twentieth-century swimwear.
